picks.headline: PyTorch 2.15 Adds NVFP4 Blackwell Support and Rewritten NCCL Backend
picks.why: The release introduces native FP4 execution for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs alongside automated hang flight recording to debug distributed training failures.
picks.title: PyTorch 2.15 Release Blog

picks.headline: Google Releases EmbeddingGemma 2 for Unified Multimodal Embeddings
picks.why: It projects text, image, audio, and video into a single representation space while outperforming open models twelve times its size.
picks.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations

picks.headline: Measurement Study Exposes Widespread Prompt and Title Leaks in AI Chatbots
picks.why: An audit of 42 consumer AI chat platforms revealed that half leak conversation titles and nine transmit raw user prompts to third-party web trackers.
picks.title: Penny for Your Prompts: A Measurement Study of Contextual Leakage in AI Chat Platforms

picks.headline: Anthropic Donates Agent Skills Standard to Open Agentic AI Foundation
picks.why: Transitioning the Agent Skills specification to an open foundation helps prevent vendor lock-in for enterprise agent tool interfaces.
picks.title: Product

picks.headline: Study Shows Interface Design Dictates Web Vulnerability Exploitation in AI Agents
picks.why: Benchmarking 44 web vulnerabilities demonstrated that frontend system design—not the choice of LLM—primarily determines whether an agent can be exploited.
picks.title: The Agent in the Middle: How AI-Mediated Access Reshapes Web Vulnerability Exploitation

papers.headline: Simple Test-Time Compute Scaling Outperforms Specialized Formal Proving Pipelines
papers.why: Scaling simple agentic search loops with verifier feedback in Lean 4 beats complex hand-engineered theorem-proving agent workflows.
papers.title: h1: A Taste of the Bitter Lesson in Automated Theorem Proving

papers.headline: Agent Post-Training Implicitly Bakes Harness Preferences into Model Weights
papers.why: KL-regularized post-training causes policies to overfit to training harness scaffolding, leading to performance drops when evaluated in different runtime environments.
papers.title: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: The Decision Geometry of Agent Interfaces

papers.headline: TAO Framework Optimizes GPU Placement and Serving for Dynamic Agent Workflows
papers.why: It dynamically schedules agent sessions by co-optimizing tool execution delays, token footprints, and KV-cache locality across serving clusters.
papers.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
